title: Levi son of Rav Huna bar Chiyya

paragraphs: Levi son of Rav Huna bar Hiyya.

His mother was the daughter of Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba. [Shabbat 156a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.156a.3) relates that Levi found the kneader at the Nasi’s household kneading fodder and feeding it to his ox, and struck him. His father, Rav Huna bar Chiyya, came and said to him, “Thus said your mother’s father in the name of Rav”—namely, Rav Yirmeyah bar Abba.

Likewise in [Chullin 93a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.93a.11): Rav Yehuda bar Oshaya was peeling a spleen for Levi son of Rav Huna bar Chiyya. His father came and said, “Thus said your mother’s father”—namely, Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba. Levi was a student of Rabbah bar Rav Huna. In [Shabbat 51b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.51b.18)–[Shabbat 52a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.52a.1), once he was travelling with Rabbah bar Rav Huna, and Levi’s donkey overtook Rabbah bar Rav Huna’s donkey. Rabbah was distressed. Levi said, “Let me say something to him to put his mind at ease,” and asked him about an ill-tempered donkey. He replied, “Thus said your father,” etc. It appears to Hyman that the Levi mentioned in [Chullin 134b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.134b.3)—who sowed in Kishar, a place name, and, finding no poor people to take the gleanings, came before Rav Sheshet—was Levi son of Rav Huna bar Chiyya.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Shabbat 156a says Levi’s in-laws’ household, where Hyman has the Nasi’s household. The Shabbat and Chullin passages name Yirmeyah bar Abba as his maternal grandfather. In the donkey episode, Levi asks about the halter, and Rabbah cites Levi’s father in Shmuel’s name. The Kishar passage names only Levi; Hyman proposes identifying him with Levi son of Rav Huna bar Chiyya.
